meaning.en: A mud ox thrown into the sea: gone for good, never heard of again.
meaning.zh: 泥做的牛掉进海里就化了，比喻一去不复返，没有消息。

examples.zh: 寄出的申请泥牛入海，一直没有回音。
examples.en: The application I sent vanished without trace and never got a reply.

examples.zh: 他借出去的钱如泥牛入海。
examples.en: The money he lent disappeared for good.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“如泥牛入海”。

meaning.en: Setting one's sights too high and being proud with it.
meaning.zh: 自视很高，傲慢自大。

equivalents: too proud for one's own good

examples.zh: 他年轻时心高气傲，不肯听别人的建议。
examples.en: As a young man he was proud and wouldn't take advice.

examples.zh: 心高气傲的人往往容易受挫。
examples.en: Those who are proud and high-aiming are often easily disappointed.

literal: lower · standard · in order to · seek

meaning.en: To lower one's standards in order to get what one needs.
meaning.zh: 降低标准以求得到。

examples.zh: 找不到理想的工作，他只好降格以求。
examples.en: Unable to find his ideal job, he had to settle for less.

examples.zh: 招聘时不能降格以求，要保证质量。
examples.en: Don't lower your standards when hiring; quality must be assured.

meaning.en: A beautiful young woman dies.
meaning.zh: 比喻年轻美丽的女子去世。

equivalents: the early death of a lovely woman

examples.zh: 一场车祸让这位女演员香消玉殒。
examples.en: A car accident ended the young actress's life.

examples.zh: 读到黛玉香消玉殒，许多读者落泪。
examples.en: Many readers weep when Daiyu dies.

usage.zh: 多指年轻女子，书面、哀惋。

natural: enrich the state and strengthen the army

meaning.en: To make a country wealthy and its army strong.
meaning.zh: 使国家富裕，军队强大。

equivalents: enrich the country and strengthen the army

examples.zh: 商鞅变法的目标是富国强兵。
examples.en: The aim of Shang Yang's reforms was to enrich the state and strengthen its army.

examples.zh: 明治维新以富国强兵为口号。
examples.en: The Meiji Restoration took 'rich country, strong army' as its slogan.

usage.zh: 可作谓语、宾语，多用于历史语境。

meaning.en: Love for a person extends to everything connected with them.
meaning.zh: 喜爱一个人，连带喜爱和他有关的人或物。

examples.zh: 她爱屋及乌，连丈夫的猫也特别疼爱。
examples.en: Her love extends to all that is his, even her husband's cat.

examples.zh: 爱屋及乌，他对女友的家人也很好。
examples.en: Love me, love my dog: he's kind to his girlfriend's family too.

story.en: Shangshu Dazhuan: 'One who loves a person loves the crows on his roof' (爱人者，兼其屋上之乌).
story.zh: 《尚书大传》：“爱人者，兼其屋上之乌。”

natural: a confession beaten out of someone

meaning.en: To be beaten until one confesses to a crime one didn't commit.
meaning.zh: 无罪的人被拷打逼供，被迫认罪。

examples.zh: 他被屈打成招，坐了十年牢。
examples.en: He was forced by beatings to confess and served ten years.

examples.zh: 历史上屈打成招的冤案不少。
examples.en: History has many miscarriages of justice resting on forced confessions.

usage.en: Predicate, often passive 被屈打成招.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“被屈打成招”。

literal: draw · sword · toward each other · face

meaning.en: To draw swords on one another; to turn violently against someone.
meaning.zh: 拔出刀来对着对方，比喻双方发生激烈冲突。

examples.zh: 两个老朋友竟然为了钱拔刀相向。
examples.en: Two old friends came to blows over money.

examples.zh: 不要因为小事就拔刀相向。
examples.en: Don't turn on each other over trifles.

literal: call oneself · king · call oneself · hegemon

meaning.en: To style oneself king and tyrant: to throw one's weight around.
meaning.zh: 自称王或霸主，比喻独断专行、欺压他人。

examples.zh: 他在村里称王称霸，没人敢惹。
examples.en: He lords it over the village and nobody dares cross him.

examples.zh: 大国不应该在世界上称王称霸。
examples.en: Great powers shouldn't throw their weight around the world.

meaning.en: Standing alone at the top, without equal in the land.
meaning.zh: 在天下独一无二，无人可比。

examples.zh: 他的书法独步天下，无人能及。
examples.en: His calligraphy is peerless and no one equals it.

examples.zh: 这家老店的烧饼独步天下。
examples.en: This old shop's baked flatbreads are second to none.

meaning.en: Narrow prejudice in favour of one's own school or faction.
meaning.zh: 因学派、宗派或集团不同而产生的偏见。

examples.zh: 学术研究要打破门户之见。
examples.en: Academic research must break through factional prejudice.

examples.zh: 两个部门有门户之见，合作不畅。
examples.en: The two departments are clannish, and cooperation is poor.

usage.zh: 常作“有”“打破”“消除”的宾语。

meaning.en: Famous mountains and great rivers; scenic grandeur.
meaning.zh: 著名的山和大的河流，泛指壮丽的自然风光。

examples.zh: 他一生走遍了祖国的名山大川。
examples.en: He travelled all his life to the famous mountains and rivers of his homeland.

examples.zh: 画家擅长描绘名山大川。
examples.en: The painter excels at depicting majestic landscapes.

meaning.en: To bring about one's own ruin.
meaning.zh: 自己给自己造成灭亡的条件。

examples.zh: 偷工减料等于自掘坟墓。
examples.en: Cutting corners is digging your own grave.

examples.zh: 欺骗客户只会自掘坟墓。
examples.en: Deceiving customers will only ruin you.

meaning.en: Elated and self-satisfied after achieving one's goals.
meaning.zh: 愿望实现，十分得意满足。

examples.zh: 拿到冠军后他志得意满。
examples.en: After taking the title he was flushed with success.

examples.zh: 他志得意满地回到了家乡。
examples.en: Full of self-satisfaction, he returned to his hometown.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; may suggest complacency.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、状语，略含自满。

meaning.en: Partly true and partly false; hard to tell whether serious.
meaning.zh: 一半真，一半假，真假难辨。

examples.zh: 他半真半假地说要辞职。
examples.en: He said, half in jest, that he'd quit.

examples.zh: 这篇报道半真半假，不能全信。
examples.en: The report is half true and half false; it can't be fully trusted.

meaning.en: To split a group and make it collapse.
meaning.zh: 使内部分裂，瓦解崩溃。

examples.zh: 敌人企图分化瓦解我们的队伍。
examples.en: The enemy tried to split and break up our ranks.

examples.zh: 内部矛盾导致联盟分化瓦解。
examples.en: Internal conflicts caused the alliance to fall apart.

meaning.en: A tiny amount; the slightest bit.
meaning.zh: 形容极少的一点儿。

examples.zh: 他心里没有一星半点的怨恨。
examples.en: There isn't the slightest resentment in his heart.

examples.zh: 这件事我一星半点也不知道。
examples.en: I don't know the first thing about it.

meaning.en: To fail to understand the situation and act accordingly.
meaning.zh: 不认识当前形势，不懂得顺应时势。

examples.zh: 他不识时务，还在坚持旧方法。
examples.en: He fails to read the times and sticks to the old methods.

examples.zh: 不识时务的人容易吃亏。
examples.en: Those who can't read the situation often lose out.

meaning.en: Having both talent and good looks.
meaning.zh: 才华和容貌都很出众。

examples.zh: 她才貌双全，追求者众多。
examples.en: Gifted and beautiful, she has many admirers.

examples.zh: 才貌双全的他很受欢迎。
examples.en: Talented and handsome, he is very popular.

usage.en: Of a person; attributive or predicate.

meaning.en: Without a rival anywhere; unbeatable.
meaning.zh: 世上没有对手，无人能敌。

examples.zh: 这位拳王一度天下无敌。
examples.en: The boxing champion was for a time unbeatable.

examples.zh: 别以为自己天下无敌，山外有山。
examples.en: Don't think you're invincible; there's always someone better.

literal: to the limit · extravagance · to the extreme · desire

meaning.en: To indulge in luxury and desire without limit.
meaning.zh: 极端奢侈，毫无节制地追求享受。

examples.zh: 末代皇帝穷奢极欲，终致亡国。
examples.en: The last emperor lived in boundless luxury and lost his kingdom.

examples.zh: 他靠贪污过着穷奢极欲的生活。
examples.en: He lived a life of lavish excess on embezzled money.
